summary: Independently RE-VERIFIED the headline round-6 result: the FULL n=6 three-minus closed form (student-1 s1_018) is EXACT. I rebuilt my oracle from a fresh copy of bg.cpp (byte-identical to shared) and wrote my OWN evaluator of the candidate (bots/pi/code/pi_r7_independent.py + pi_r7_walls.py) -- my own group(72)/orbit-sum/truncated-power/assembly logic, importing NO student code, taking only the published reference polynomials (r6_polys.txt + the s1_015 Q) as the formula under test. Results, all EXACT: 140/140 generic points across 58 distinct chamber labels; 6/6 non-generic regimes (one freq >> or << the rest); 3/3 g-homogeneity (g=2,1/3,7/2); two-sided wall limits onto a (1=1), a (1=2), AND a matching corner down to eps=1e-4; N_6 odd (10/10) and A_6 homogeneous degree 8 (10/10). So n=6 is CLOSED: A_6 = i 2^5 g^-3 N_6/(e3m+e3p) with N_6 = B + sum(b_j-a_i)_+ P_ij + sum(b_j-a_i)_+(b_l-a_k)_+ R + sum(a_i-b_j-b_k)_+^3 Q, a degree-11 box spline. Also reconfirmed n=5 (24/24 exact, fresh oracle) and CORROBORATED student-2's all-n minimal denominator s2_018 (PI symbolic check: r_n = Q_n mod p_- is degree 0 only at n=6, where r_6=e3m+e3p exactly, and degree 1 at n=7 -> no collapse, full 12-pair product minimal, deg N_7=22). DECISION: did NOT write SOLVED.md -- the task asks for all n>=5 and the explicit numerator N_n for n>=7 (the single all-n closed form) is still OPEN; the n>=7 regime is genuinely new (Z_2 swap is no longer a symmetry; matchings become injections; (1=1) edges couple to subset-sum walls). Assigned both students to the n>=7 numerator.
